operative_version: Adopted window must be independently assessed; neither document filename nor retrieval date establishes commencement or entity applicability.
scope: Company filing timetable under assessed section 415 duty/exemptions, section 416 triggers and section 417 month-end rules.
Private/public status is assessed immediately before reference period end. Accounting reference and accounts periods remain separate.
Long first period compares anniversary plus nine/six months with reference end plus three. Shortening adds its notice candidate.
Following-day adjustment needs its separately retained complete calendar. No national holidays are invented.

An extension needs a timezone-aware application timestamp and separate original authority outcome; latest permitted date is bounded by the adopted three-month and twelve-month limits. No ORS execution occurs.
qualification_limits: No full review of the 633-page regulations, all operative amendments, audit exemptions, required report content, QFZP, ESG or all legal forms.
Filing duty/exemptions and period validity are explicit independent assessments, not automatically established legal conclusions.
LLPs, foundations, foreign branches, unresolved modifications, leap-day incorporation anniversaries and distinct notice/receipt dates require separate qualification.
Original PDFs must be uploaded as separate evidence and independently reviewed in each actual engagement; repository possession alone is insufficient.
The new UI/browser workflow has not yet executed in hosted CI.

Section 381 validity, prior alterations, administration and Registrar directions remain retained independent period-validity assessments. First financial year must start at incorporation; inclusive six/twelve/eighteen-month boundaries have explicit fixtures.

working_week_source.assessment: Official ADGM announcement specifies Monday-Friday working week and Saturday/Sunday weekend from 2022-01-01. This does not establish the complete holiday calendar; that remains separate retained original evidence.
